senses.gloss: m. (עטה to press on; cmp. יעץ, יעט; v.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 55b:4">Sabb. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>בת מי שמת בעֶטְיוֹ של נחש</he> the daughter of him who died (for the sin committed) through the instigation of the serpent, i.e. for no sin of his own; <cite ref="Bava Batra 17a">B. Bath. 17ᵃ</cite> (cmp.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 4:22">Targ. Ruth IV, 22</cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 4:22">Ib.</cite> <he>ארבעה מתו בעטיו של נחש</he> four persons died through no sin of their own.—V. <cite ref="P00529"><he>עֵיטָא</he></cite>.
